name: Product

layouts.description: Product render cover with a sharp value proposition and launch metadata.
Problem and solution split screen with a visual transition between both states.

Workflow steps paired with a product screenshot and a protected copy zone.

Quarter-based roadmap with milestones, owners, and dependency notes.
Launch close with product image, one action, and a concise proof statement.
